messages:
anya: Heads-up — saw a 2-3x higher 95p latency for halo6b qlora-4bit on canary vs baseline float16 for bs=8, seq=2048. Noticed spikes after token ~32.
kevin: saw same on perf dashboard, linked traces: https://redwood.infra/traces/abc123 — per-token GPU time jumps.
matt: which workload exactly? bs8 seq2048 or the seq1024 runs?
anya: bs8 seq2048, mixture of code+text prompts. baseline halo6b/float16 is stable.
leila: deploy-bot: Deployed halo6b/qlora-4bit to canary @ 2026-02-10T12:14Z (route=100%)
ciaran: quick sanity: is KV cache being used? fallback to non-cached path could blow latency.
kevin: KV metrics show kv_cache_miss=0.0 but the profiler shows big GPU memcpy spikes. snippet: ```[GPU] memcpy_htod: 1.2ms -> 12ms spike at token 35; kernel fallback: attention_unopt_v1 invoked```
matt: can you repro locally? try: `./tools/run_bench --model halo6b --quant qlora-4bit --bs 8 --seq 2048 --warmup 50`
anya: repro worked on my devbox. profile shows kernel selector falling back to unoptimized attention when seq > 64 for this quant profile.
leila: fallback usually means kernel probe thought layout incompatible; might be quant packing/layout mismatch.
ciaran: tokenizer differences? longer tokenization could change attention shape, but baseline float16 didn't show this. suspect runtime kernel selection mismatch with quant artifacts.
kevin: quick experiment: set `use_legacy_kv=false` in runtime config -> stops fallback and 95p drops ~40% but memory increases ~200MB. Not ideal but confirms fallback is root cause.
matt: for safety, split canary routing: route 50% to float16, 50% to qlora until we fix. Use `model_variant_priority` policy.
leila: created ticket ML-7237 with traces, bench outputs, and perf graphs.
anya: action items: (1) Kevin bisect qlora quant packing/config that causes kernel mismatch; (2) Ciaran add assert in kernel selector to surface packing/layout mismatch earlier; (3) Matt apply split routing and alert on 95p degradation.
ciaran: also saw a small quality regression on our Wikitext/code eval: +1.8 ppl on code subset vs float16. logging eval config to ML-7237.
kevin: note — the QLoRA adapter save step had an adapter-serialization change in the latest qlora-utils that changed packing order (row-major vs col-major). Might explain selector mismatch.
matt: hotfix plan: set runtime flag `force_kernel=optimized_attention_v2` for canary qlora variant and monitor.
anya: :thumbsup: running that now, will report back in 15m.
leila: runbook note: /runbooks/halo6b-onboard.md — adding qlora-4bit caveats.
deploy-bot: Canary routing change applied by matt — float16:50% / qlora-4bit:50%
anya: after forcing kernel we see partial improvement but 95p still ~25% above baseline. continuing bisect.
kevin: found culprit in adapter packing: when saving quant adapters the order flag `adapter_transpose=true` got flipped in qlora-utils v0.9.2; runtime expected non-transposed. Patch ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3124 (fix packing order + add packing tag in artifact).
matt: add regression unit test and a tiny e2e perf check to the CI so we catch this earlier.
ciaran: will add an assert in kernel selector: if artifact packing tag != runtime_expected -> fail early with clear error.
kevin: PR LGTM pending tests.
ciaran: merging now.
deploy-bot: PR merged and new artifacts published. Rolling canary update to corrected qlora-4bit artifacts.
anya: post-merge numbers: 95p latency back within 5% of baseline float16, memory overhead acceptable. Wikitext/code ppl diff now +0.2 (non-actionable). Closing ML-7237.
kevin: follow-up: add onboarding checklist item — "verify artifact packing/layout tag matches runtime kernel selector" and include the bench command and perf targets.
leila: updated intake checklist and halo6b onboarding doc. Added note for qlora: include artifact packing metadata and a quick perf smoke (bs=8 seq=2048).
anya: thanks all for quick triage. will archive traces and link ticket in release notes.
